## History

Tillie Boulter attended the local school alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). During a class day, she was present when [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) teased [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by pulling her braid, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to smash her slate over his head and receive a punishment from Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md).
